points.title: 童年与青少年时期
points.description: 费里尼1920年1月20日出生于意大利里米尼的一个中产阶级家庭。他的父亲是一位小商人，母亲则来自富裕的农民家庭。童年时期，费里尼对马戏团、杂技表演和电影表现出浓厚兴趣，这些元素后来成为他电影中反复出现的主题。在里米尼的这段经历塑造了他对奇幻、超现实元素的敏感度，以及对社会边缘人物的关注。1938年，他离开家乡前往佛罗伦萨，开始在多家报纸和杂志担任记者和漫画家，这段经历培养了他的视觉叙事能力。
points.descriptionEn: Born on January 20, 1920, in Rimini to a middle-class family, Fellini's childhood was marked by his fascination with circuses, vaudeville shows, and cinema, which later became recurring motifs in his films. Growing up in Rimini shaped his sensitivity to fantasy and surreal elements, as well as his attention to marginalized figures. In 1938, he left his hometown for Florence, where he worked as a journalist and cartoonist for various newspapers and magazines, developing his visual storytelling skills that would later define his cinematic style.

points.title: 早期创作与战争经历
points.description: 1939年，费里尼移居罗马，开始在电影界担任编剧助理，与导演阿尔贝托·拉图瓦达合作。这一时期，他参与了多部电影的剧本创作，包括《白酋长》(1952)和《爱情三部曲》(1953)，这些作品展现了他独特的幽默感和对人性的洞察。第二次世界大战期间，费里尼被迫为德国占领军制作宣传影片，这段经历让他对权力与艺术的关系有了深刻思考。战争结束后，他与妻子朱丽叶塔·马西纳结婚，后者成为他许多重要作品中的缪斯和女主角。
points.descriptionEn: In 1939, Fellini moved to Rome and began working as a script assistant for director Alberto Lattuada, collaborating on films such as 'The White Sheik' (1952) and 'Variety Lights' (1953), which showcased his unique humor and insight into human nature. During World War II, Fellini was forced to make propaganda films for the German occupation, an experience that profoundly influenced his views on the relationship between power and art. After the war, he married actress Giulietta Masina, who became his muse and leading lady in many of his important works.

points.title: 国际声誉确立
points.description: 这一时期是费里尼创作生涯的黄金阶段。1954年，他执导的《大路》获得威尼斯电影节金狮奖，确立了他在国际影坛的地位。随后，《卡比利亚之夜》(1957)、《甜蜜的生活》(1960)等作品相继问世，这些影片以独特的视觉风格和对现代社会的深刻剖析而闻名。《甜蜜的生活》更是成为电影史上的经典之作，其对罗马社会生活的描绘和对资产阶级生活方式的批判引发了广泛讨论。这一时期的作品奠定了费里尼作为意大利新现实主义继承者和创新者的地位，他的电影融合了现实主义与超现实主义元素，创造出独特的'费里尼式'美学。
points.descriptionEn: This period marked the golden age of Fellini's career. In 1954, 'La Strada' won the Venice Film Festival's Golden Lion, establishing his international reputation. Subsequent works like 'Nights of Cabiria' (1957) and 'La Dolce Vita' (1960) followed, renowned for their distinctive visual style and profound analysis of modern society. 'La Dolce Vita' became a classic in film history, sparking widespread discussion with its depiction of Roman social life and critique of bourgeois lifestyles. These works solidified Fellini's position as both an heir and innovator of Italian neorealism, blending realism with surrealism to create his unique 'Fellini-esque' aesthetic.

points.title: 艺术巅峰与实验探索
points.description: 1960年代至1970年代初，费里尼进入创作巅峰期，作品风格更加实验性和自传性。《八部半》(1963)被视为他最具代表性的作品之一，通过导演圭多的内心独白，探索了创作危机、记忆与幻想的交织，该片获得奥斯卡最佳外语片奖。随后，《萨蒂利孔》(1969)、《罗马风情画》(1972)等作品进一步展现了他对梦境、记忆和潜意识世界的探索。这一时期，费里尼的电影语言更加自由奔放，视觉元素更加丰富多变，他开始将个人记忆与集体无意识融合，创造出独特的电影诗学。这些作品不仅巩固了他的艺术地位，也影响了世界电影的发展方向。
points.descriptionEn: From the 1960s to the early 1970s, Fellini entered his creative peak with more experimental and autobiographical works. '8½' (1963), considered one of his most representative films, explores creative crisis and the interplay of memory and fantasy through director Guido's inner monologue, winning the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film. Subsequent works like 'Satyricon' (1969) and 'Roma' (1972) further demonstrated his exploration of dreams, memory, and the subconscious. During this period, Fellini's cinematic language became more free and expressive, with richer visual elements, as he began to merge personal memory with collective unconscious, creating a unique cinematic poetics that influenced global cinema development.

points.title: 晚年创作与遗产
points.description: 1974年后，费里尼的创作进入晚期阶段，作品风格更加内省和哲学化。《阿玛柯德》(1973)、《船行》(1983)、《采访》(1987)等作品继续探索记忆、身份和存在的主题。这一时期，费里尼获得了众多国际荣誉，包括奥斯卡终身成就奖(1985)和威尼斯电影节终身成就奖(1992)。他的作品对后世导演产生了深远影响，包括马丁·斯科塞斯、伍迪·艾伦和大卫·林奇等。1993年10月31日，费里尼在罗马逝世，享年73岁。他的电影遗产不仅体现在独特的视觉风格和叙事技巧上，更在于他对人类精神世界的深刻探索和对现代社会异化的批判，使他成为世界电影史上最具影响力的导演之一。
points.descriptionEn: After 1974, Fellini's work entered a late phase characterized by more introspective and philosophical themes. Films like 'Amarcord' (1973), 'And the Ship Sails On' (1983), and 'The Interview' (1987) continued to explore memory, identity, and existence. During this period, Fellini received numerous international honors, including the Academy Honorary Award (1985) and the Venice Film Festival's Lifetime Achievement Award (1992). His work profoundly influenced later directors including Martin Scorsese, Woody Allen, and David Lynch. On October 31, 1993, Fellini died in Rome at the age of 73. His cinematic legacy lies not only in his distinctive visual style and narrative techniques but also in his profound exploration of the human spirit and critique of modern alienation, establishing him as one of the most influential directors in film history.

appraisal.zh: 费里尼被公认为意大利电影黄金时代的关键人物和世界影史最具影响力的导演之一，他以梦境与现实交织的视觉语言拓展了电影的叙事边界，创造出独特的「费里尼式」美学，深刻影响了后世导演。不过也有研究者指出，他的作品常被指自我沉溺、偏重个人幻想而疏离社会现实，女性角色多被简化为幻想或母亲形象，后期作品亦显出主题与视觉元素的重复。
appraisal.en: Fellini is widely recognized as a key figure of Italian cinema's golden age and one of the most influential directors in film history, expanding cinema's narrative boundaries through a visual language blending dream and reality and creating a distinctive Felliniesque aesthetic that deeply influenced later directors. Yet some researchers note that his films have been called self-indulgent, favoring personal fantasy over social reality, that his female characters are often reduced to fantasy or maternal figures, and that his later works repeat themes and imagery.

supporter.zh: 费里尼被誉为电影界的诗人，他的作品超越了简单的叙事，成为人类精神世界的视觉探索。支持者认为他通过独特的视觉语言和丰富的想象力，揭示了现代社会的荒诞与异化，同时保留了对人性的温暖关怀。他的电影融合了梦境与现实、记忆与幻想，创造出独特的'费里尼式'美学，影响了无数后世导演。费里尼的遗产不仅在于技术上的创新，更在于他敢于探索人类内心深处的勇气，以及对艺术纯粹性的坚持。
supporter.en: Fellini is celebrated as a poet of cinema, whose works transcend simple narrative to become visual explorations of the human spirit. Supporters argue that through his unique visual language and rich imagination, he revealed the absurdity and alienation of modern society while maintaining a warm concern for humanity. His films blend dreams with reality, memory with fantasy, creating a distinctive 'Felliniesque' aesthetic that has influenced countless directors. Fellini's legacy lies not only in technical innovation but in his courage to explore the depths of human consciousness and his commitment to artistic purity.

critic.zh: 批评者指出费里尼的电影常常被指责为自我放纵和精英主义，过于关注个人幻想而忽视社会现实。他们认为费里尼的作品中女性角色常常被简化为幻想对象或母亲形象，反映了性别观念的局限性。此外，费里尼对资产阶级生活方式的描绘有时被批评为表面化，未能深入分析其结构性问题。一些评论家还认为，他的后期作品重复使用相似的主题和视觉元素，缺乏创新性，显示出创作力的衰退。
critic.en: Critics argue that Fellini's films are often accused of self-indulgence and elitism, focusing too much on personal fantasy while neglecting social reality. They point out that female characters in his work are frequently reduced to fantasy figures or maternal figures, reflecting limitations in his gender perspective. Additionally, Fellini's depictions of bourgeois lifestyles have been criticized as superficial, failing to analyze their structural problems. Some commentators also suggest that his later works重复使用 similar themes and visual elements, lacking innovation and showing signs of creative decline.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，费里尼被定义为意大利电影黄金时代的关键人物，也是世界电影史上最具影响力的导演之一。他的作品超越了国界和文化差异，成为人类共同体验的视觉表达。费里尼的名字已成为一种文化符号，代表着对梦幻与现实边界的探索和对人类精神世界的关注。他的电影不仅影响了艺术电影的发展，也对商业电影产生了深远影响。在当代流行文化中，'费里尼式'已成为描述那些充满幻想、怀旧和视觉奇观的作品的形容词，证明了他的持久影响力。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Fellini is recognized as a key figure in the golden age of Italian cinema and one of the most influential directors in film history. His works transcend national and cultural boundaries, becoming visual expressions of shared human experiences. The name 'Fellini' has become a cultural symbol representing exploration of the boundaries between fantasy and reality and attention to the human spirit. His films have influenced not only art cinema but also had a profound impact on commercial filmmaking. In contemporary popular culture, 'Felliniesque' has become an adjective describing works filled with fantasy, nostalgia, and visual spectacles, demonstrating his enduring influence.

self.zh: 生活就是一部电影，而电影就是生活。
self.en: Life is a combination of magic and pasta.
